sources.name: Microsoft Rocketbox Avatar Library
sources.source_status: 22 avatar source sets archived with private Drive provider readback; 93 remaining
sources.notes: Public repository archived 2026-10-02; multi-GB and source assets are not GLB-ready. Keep license notice when distributing. Partial source acquisition 2026-11-13: four archived model ZIPs (medical FBX-only), two sample animation FBXs in one archive; exact Drive IDs confined to private receipt; GLB conversion initially failed due missing Blender numpy and is not yet validated. Two GLBs in Drive passed actual WebGL2/Three.js r185 loader, mixer, rendered triangles and reload checks; not fully released. Batch02 added eight more complete original avatar archives to Drive (103 of 115 still pending), and four additional GLBs passed Chromium Three.js r185 skinned texture and animation-mixer render/reload smoke. Source/package SHA-256 verified before upload; Google Drive metadata readback confirmed size/parent; no Drive roundtrip byte hash, visual approval, mobile benchmark or long-session proof. See batch02 private receipts. Completion run 43551948111 converted four earlier source-only batch02 models and smoke tested all ten GLBs, archived twenty separate Chrome render screenshots and private receipts. Darker browser-render facial/material exposure than source previews flagged for visual QA; no production approval. Source archive count unchanged. Cloud remaining-source pilot group0 acquired 10 original avatars into five Drive-verified nested transport packs; 93 original avatar sources remain. No new GLB conversion or visual signoff.
